product.title: Orlando City Lights and Fireworks Premier Helicopter Tour

description.text: Experience Orlando after dark from a premier helicopter flight with city lights, theme-park skylines, and seasonal fireworks views when schedules allow. Digital photo package included. Stops include Downtown Orlando, Disney Springs, Gaylord Palms Resort & Convention Center. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Central Florida's wildlife, coastlines, and space-coast sights. Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
